scripts.release:rehearse: node scripts/release.mjs build /tmp/fevex-release && node scripts/release.mjs smoke /tmp/fevex-release && node scripts/release.mjs inspect /tmp/fevex-release
scripts.eval:gate:package: bun run --cwd packages/fevex build && bun run scripts/eval-gate-package.ts
scripts.build: set -e; for d in packages/* examples/* apps/web; do if [ -f "$d/package.json" ]; then (cd "$d" && bun run build); fi; done
scripts.test: set -e; for d in packages/*; do if [ -f "$d/package.json" ]; then (cd "$d" && bun run test); fi; done; bun run --cwd examples/nest-api test
scripts.typecheck: set -e; for d in packages/* examples/* apps/web; do if [ -f "$d/package.json" ]; then (cd "$d" && bun run typecheck); fi; done
